q: We have a steam flow meter. Can we calculate boiler emissions from steam instead of fuel?
title: Steam meter or fuel records for emissions
short: Calculate emissions from fuel, not steam. Scope 1 is the fuel burnt times its emission factor; the steam meter tells you how well the boiler converts fuel to steam. Use steam readings to check fuel records, to work out CO2 per tonne of steam, and to split emissions between departments.
audience: Plants with steam meters on boilers or headers

ul: Steam meter: efficiency, CO2 per tonne of steam, allocation to products or units.
Both together: a cross-check that catches missing fuel invoices.

sections.h: When steam is the only data
p: If fuel records are missing for a month, estimate fuel from steam and a measured boiler efficiency, and label the figure as an estimate.
Steam meters drift. Keep the calibration date and compare monthly steam per tonne of fuel; a sudden change usually means the meter, not the boiler.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices, gas bills and delivery documents into dated, fingerprinted records, so each tonne of CO2 traces back to the document behind it.
